title: Misc equipment slots: pet, light pet, minecart, mount, hook (Core model, save, slots)
player_outcome: Terraria's five misc equipment slots (Pet, Light Pet, Minecart, Mount, Hook) appear next to the armour. A hook goes in the hook slot. The minecart slot is used by a quick-mount key (G).
design: Verified: EquipSlot is { None, Head, Body, Legs, Accessory }. PlayerInventory has only Backpack, Armor and Accessories. Hooks are found by PlayerController.BestHook (PlayerController.Grapple.cs:39).
EquipSlot gains Pet, LightPet, Minecart, Mount, Hook. PlayerInventory.Misc = new Inventory(5) in Terraria's order (pet, light pet, minecart, mount, hook), plus MiscIndex(EquipSlot).
Equip() handles the new slots (swap); EquippedStacks includes Misc, so light-pet emitLight effects apply.
PlayerSave: Misc slot list (added without a version bump, like Look).
SlotActions.ArmorFilter(EquipSlot) reused as the slot filter.
Validator: category hook ⇒ equipSlot hook; category pet ⇒ pet or lightPet; the minecart item ⇒ minecart.

input.json: quick_mount on key:G. InteractionController on quick_mount: when standing on a track, board it using the minecart slot item (existing Minecart behaviour via ItemUseSystem.Mount); an empty mount slot gives a Refused 'No mount equipped'.
UI: InventoryScreen adds a 5-slot misc column below the accessories using ItemSlotView, with slot labels. If P2's equipment panel has landed, register the slots through its factory instead.
CombatCommands 'equip' handles misc items; StandardProbes adds misc.<pet|light_pet|minecart|mount|hook>.
files_modify: game/Settings/KeyBindings.cs — list quick_mount for rebinding (if the list is explicit)
tests: MiscEquipTests: Equip(grappling_hook) lands in Misc[4]; swapping hooks returns the old one to the backpack
MiscEquipTests: PlayerSave round-trip keeps Misc; a light-pet item with emitLight sets Effects.Light
verification: Menu tour and smoke PASS; screenshot of the inventory showing misc slots
risks: InventoryScreen.cs is P2's main file; coordinate (P2 may own final layout).
G may collide with a P2 smart-cursor binding; confirm against P2's input plan.
